pop culture fix

Everything We Know About Rebecca Ferguson and Greta Lee’s Sapphic Rom-Com

Valerie Anne
—
Sep 9, 2026
COMMENT (4)

feature image photo by STEFANO RELLANDINI / Contributor via Getty Images

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:22
Instaread

News of the upcoming Rebecca Ferguson and Greta Lee film broke in a mysterious way: with cell phone photos that caught them canoodling on set. We didn’t know much for a while, but more information has been slowly but surely coming out, so here’s what we know so far:

  • The name of the movie is Honeymoon/Funeral, and it has been filming in London.
  • It will be directed by lesbian creator Nahnatchka Khan and gay screenwriter Julia Bicknell (who also wrote on Haunting of Bly Manor and Yellowjackets, so…consider me a fan already).
  • The two women played by Ferguson and Lee will meet on a 10-hour flight and then proceed to spend a week in London together (which we all know is basically a year-long relationship for lesbians).
  • Ferguson’s character is returning home for her mother’s funeral.
  • Lee’s character will be going on her honeymoon alone after being left at the altar.
  • Carrie Coon will be playing said ex who left Lee’s character at the altar.
  • Rebecca Ferguson and Greta Lee have previously worked together on Kathryn Bigelow’s 2025 political thriller A House of Dynamite.
  • None of the three actors tied to this project, as far as I can tell, have played queer before (nor does it seem like any have publicly identified as queer…but we’ve all seen Rebecca Ferguson flirting with women on red carpets sooooo…)

Sadly that is all the information we have at this time, but I, for one, am excited to see such a big names attached to a sapphic project. I love a lesbian romcom, though nothing has ever captured my heart quite like Imagine Me & You…here’s hoping this one takes the cake.

Of course, we’ll keep our eyes peeled for more information as it comes in, and when we know more, you’ll know more!

More News for You

+ Queer Broadway star Denée Benton talks about her upcoming queer road trip movie created by nonbinary filmmaker Shatara Michelle Ford

+ On this season of Dancing with the Stars, bisexual reality star and model Sarah Jane Nader is paired with pro Hailey Bills (the show’s second two-woman pairing) and pansexual Olympic figure skater Amber Glenn will also compete

+ Apparently they are making a Jawbreaker musical???? I didn’t know this and I’m excited. And I also learned: Fern Mayo, played by Judy Greer in the movie, will be trans in the stage version and played by nonbinary actor AJ Paramo

+ Season 4 of Yellowjackets will have episodes dedicated to different girls

+ The Blood Countess, a lesbian vampire horror comedy, will make its way to North America

+ A full official trailer for Mike Flanagan’s Carrie has dropped

+ Gay-adjacent news: Alexandra Metz, who plays queer trauma surgeon Garcia on The Pitt, is joining Will Trent in the role previously held by a queer character…here’s hoping she’s queer in this show, too??

+ Ahead of her upcoming tour, queer musical artist and comeback queen Rebecca Black says “So much of what I do is made by gay people for gay people.”

+ Love Island‘s Kyra Green and her partner Tal Sahar proposed to each other and now they are en-gay-ged

+ Did you know Letitia Wright has a whole entire WIFE?
